name: Hari Nayo -Glass Mermaid-
original_name: 玻璃啼魚-グラス・マーメイド-
source:
You musn't make a sound.
The mermaids' throats haven't yet evolved the means to allow both breathing and speaking at the same time. If you make a sound, you'll lose your means of breathing...and drown.
Keep this promise, and I shall grant you legs for a single night. If you can successfully engage in "sexual relations" with a land-dweller, then you shall remain a human forever—such is the magic.

The price? It's fine, the payment can be deferred.
In any case, the illusion only lasts for a single night. A mere instant. It'll be over soon, right?

[Translated from [url=https://homeaway.booth.pm/items/3582170]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
你不许发出声音。
美人鱼的喉咙还没有进化出同时呼吸和说话的能力。如果你发出声音，你就会失去呼吸……然后淹死。
遵守这个诺言，我将赐予你一夜的双腿。如果你能成功地与陆地居民发生“性关系”，那么你将永远是人类——这就是魔法。

价格？没关系，可以延期付款。
无论如何，幻觉只持续一个晚上。只是一瞬间。很快就会结束的，对吧？

[译自[url=https://homeaway.booth.pm/items/3582170]BOOTH[/url]]
